content: Ninge Pol, ryrbo bamu, nimu kcng tznginidr leplz neng Gct, tzmncng Galesia Provins. Nigr badr mzlegung kcng tzmncng mrka, rpibzkr bamu kx, “Nimu la.” Ninge aposol murde Jiszs Kxnzmcpx nidr mz Gct Trte kc tqatulzmle nide mz nzbzngr, nzmcpxlr ninge. Delc zmatq rnge mz nzaclve-krnge lrmakxtr trvzpxpuu mz leplz.
Krka'-ngrne kx Gct Trtegu x Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx naokatrlr nimu mz zmrlz ngrdr kxmyalz, murde namnc-zpwxamu badr.

Nzmnc-zpwxngr lc vzpxm mz Kraes, murde sc tqvz-nqblqpele me pnz drtwr Gct Trte, mz nzrlrpx-lzbq-krde mz nzbzngr. Alele da lc murde rpile nakapxle alwx rgung, x na-arlapxle nigu mz nzrvz-nqblqngr nqmq kr kxdrka'-ngrng kcng tzvz-rbrng mz da kx nzaoti drtwrdr x mz da kx nzaleting.
Delc takitrde nzglqpx-krgu x nzamatq-krgu Gct Trte, tqvzpe tqvzpe. Eu. Angida!
Gct Arlapxle Leplz Mz Hxl Mz Lrpzki Esz'txu
Kctitxpxx kx esablqti-anipeamu Gct kc tqaveatile nimu mz nzmnclz-zvz-krbzmu mz zmrlz ngr Kraes kc tqmyalz. A' sc tqvz-nqblqamu nzalvztrngr kzble mz lrpzki r nzrlapxngr.
Kxmule-esz' trpnz-moungr lrpzki r nzrlapxngr, a' kzdung leplz sa tzesabrtilr nimu, mz nztekqtr-krdr Nrpakxmrlz angidr kx Kraes esz'-krde arlapxle nigu.

Pibzkr bamu da lc mzli kc tqmnc-ngrgu. X mzli ka sa tqpipe-mopwc' bamu. Takitrde Gct nzadwatr-krde doa mz Hxl, kxmule-esz' kzdq nigr aposol o kzdq enjrl kxvzom Heven nzmu kx tqalvztr-ngrde lrpzki r nzrlapxngr kx blepxbz mz da kc tqyapwxtipebzkr bamu, tqlxngitipeamu mzli kc.

Tryrpou bamu da lc murde suti drtwrnge nzabrtzlvz-krmu ninge, da kc tqwai nzpi-krdr ninge. Murde nzmu leplz nzabrtzlvz-zvzlr ninge mz nike pibo badr, trtakitrdeu nzngini-krnge kxnzawz ne Kraes. A' da kx myapxbz kx Gct na-abrtzlvzle ninge.
Nrpakxmrlz Kc Tqyapwxtipx Pol Ngi Da Angidr Murde Vzpxm Mz Kraes
Mzlengeng x inwengeng, Nrpakxmrlz kc tqyapwxtipxbo trvzpxpuu mz leplz.
X trxlrtr-kzpwc'u mz leplz. A' Jiszs Kxnzmcpx nide esz'-krde kx rpim bange, mz nzadcpx-lzbq-krmle bange.
Krlzpeamu nqmq krnge mzli kc. Murde vz-nqblq-angidrx lou x nqmq krgr amrlx. X lolvz-kzx leplz neng Kraes, mz nzadwatr-krngeleng mz presin, murde ma tzlxngitilr nide.
X myaszpxx nrpr kztengeng mz nzpqlz-krmle mz nabznge nzalvztrkr melrmqgrng.

A' trkrlzwxu kx mcpx pnz Gct ninge mzli kc mzke' trnzmcka-ngrde, mz nzngini-krnge aposol nede murde napipxbo Nrpa ngr Jiszs mz krkcng trngiulrJiu. A' mcpxle ninge mz nzvz-nqblq-krde zmrlz ngrde kxmyalz, kxmule-esz' trtakitrpwc'u nzwzngr lc. Zbz kx krlzpebzle mzli kc tqmcpx pnz Gct, sc tqvz-ngrbo Damaskzs. X sc tqaelwapxpe-ngrmle bange kx Jiszs Kxnzmcpx ngi mrlxde. A' trpnzngr ncblo kx vz-nebax kx na-alvztrle ninge mz nzrkrlzngr Kraes.
X trvz-kzwxu Jerusalem murde krkcng tzngini-kaiplr aposol bange na-alvztrlr ninge. A' mz nibr nzrkqlengr ninge, vzx mz Arabia provins. X mz nibr kzdung mzli, sc tqyzlupe-moux mz taon kc Damaskzs.
Zbz yiz tq kaputxpx, mz nibr nzrlxngiti-krnge, sc tqvzpex Jerusalem, mz nzryapwx-krgr mz Pita. Mnctikr bade zbq nzpnu-nrade-nzlvqn.
Mzli lcde, oklati-kzx aposol Jemes, mzle Kxetu rgu, kc tqaclvele dzbe lrmakxtr kc mrkc. A' tr-rmctiwxu kzdq kz aposol.
Esalzx mz mz Gct, kx da amrlx kx yrbo bamu da angidr.
Mz nibrde, sc tqyapwxtipxx Nrpakxmrlz mz provins kcng Siriz x Silisia, mrlcdeng trnzkqlu-ngru lr Jiu.
A' leplz neng Kraes kx nzmncng Judiz Provins, trnzkrlzkalr ninge, murde tr-rmcti-lzbqkakr badr.
A' nzxlr-ngrdr nrpa, kx ncblo kc tqatrkatile kxnzrlxngiting mzli kc, mzli ka sa tqryapwxpxpe kz Nrpa ngr Jiszs.
X nzglqpxlr Gct kc tqtekqtrle ninge.
